affected_predicate.description: The saved poll removes USA and replaces Brazil with Canada as separate options.

competing_trace_defects.description: The step-4 attempt to access USA's option control leaves the editor showing USA, and the subsequent screen still shows USA despite the claim that it was removed.

chains.rationale: At the reuse target, tapping Brazil merely focuses its text field; it does not open the claimed options menu and causes no visible local harm. The later text entry visibly produces “BrazilCanada,” and the saved poll still contains USA and BrazilCanada. The reused premise is therefore merely concurrent with the observed unmet poll-option predicate.

summary: The reused false menu-access premise produced no visible harm at its target; independent editing errors leave the saved poll visibly different from the requested options.
